text:
Jamal Rivera: Kicking off deploy v2.4.0 now. Primary change toggles feature flag `model-routing-dynamic` from shadow->slice. Change window 21:00-23:00 UTC. Rough plan: shadow for 30m, 2% slice, then 10%, 30%, 100. @infra-ops @Priya Singh please stand by. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.4.0 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Launching deploy_id=deploy-20240305-11. Components: route-proxy, dynamic-router. Flag actions queued: model-routing-dynamic: shadow->slice(canary-0). Dry-run of traffic slicing enabled. Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/deploy-20240305-11

Priya Singh: Quick check  are we preserving sticky sessions? New slice should honor session affinity else risk user experience jitter. Also any cost impact on tokens?

Jamal Rivera: Yes, sticky session preserved for pinned cohort. Token cost: negligible per-route; ops noted a slight increase in per-request token count for routed contexts in release notes.

infra-ops: Ack. Metric gates defined:
- gate-1 (safety): error-rate >0.8% sustained 5m -> abort
- gate-2 (perf): p95 increases by >150ms over baseline for 3/4 windows -> abort
- gate-3 (resource): router CPU > 80% for 2 consecutive mins -> pause scaling and alert
Ramp timings: shadow 30m, 2% for 8m, 10% for 12m, 30% for 15m. If any gate trips we auto-pin to `model-routing-stable-20240201` and notify channel.

release-coach: Reminding to tag release notes with migration caveats and to update the Canary checklist. Also add a smoke test that sends 50 synthetic requests across the new path and validates traces.

Jamal Rivera: Pinning stable now so rollback is an easy pin. Command in runbook: `rdw pin set --route model-routing --version model-routing-stable-20240201`. I'll run after shadow roll completes.

deploy-bot: Shadow mode enabled at 1708604340. Side-effects: sampling=10% of requests into trace logs for 2% slice, 100% tracing for shadow mode. Canary cohort created: canary-0 @2% scheduled at 1708604400.

Priya Singh: I'll add temporary Prometheus alert: `expr = increase(http_errors_total{route=\"dynamic-router\"}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{route=\"dynamic-router\"}[5m]) > 0.008` and route alert to oncall and this channel. Also enabling short-circuit kill switch command in ops-tool.

infra-ops: Rollback command (one-liner):
```
infractl rollout revert --deploy deploy-20240305-11 --to model-routing-stable-20240201
```
Use if gate-1 or gate-2 trip, or if CPU saturation persists after scaling.

deploy-bot: Canary slice 2% applied at 1708604410. Status: in-progress. Telemetry: http://telemetry.redwood/d/rr/dynamic-slice (live).

Jamal Rivera: Note: doing a soft-pin window at 10% to evaluate edge-case sessions; if all good, promote to 30%. If we see anomaly, we force unpin with `rdw pin set --route model-routing --version model-routing-stable-20240201 --force` and run infractl revert.

release-coach: Heads-up, I'll open a short post-deploy follow-up doc with observed latencies and notes for the SDK team. Keep the channel updated with each traffic step. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary 2% passed first gate checks. Next scheduled step: 10% at 1708604600.
